record.context_brief: Structure of equilibrium support on convex bodies
record.original_question: Let C⊂R^d be a compact convex body and μ_eq the equilibrium measure for the Riesz s-energy on C. Beyond knowing the dimension of supp(μ_eq), what finer structural information can be determined about the support itself?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.2 (Ryan Matzke). Find more information about the support of µeq.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ be a compact convex body and let $s \in (0,d)$ (or, in the logarithmic case, $s = 0$ with kernel $-\log|x-y|$). For a Borel probability measure $\mu$ supported on $C$, define the Riesz $s$-energy
$$I_s(\mu) \;=\; \iint_{C \times C} \frac{d\mu(x)\,d\mu(y)}{|x-y|^s}.$$
Among all probability measures supported on $C$, there exists a unique minimizer $\mu_{\mathrm{eq}}$, called the equilibrium measure of $C$ for the Riesz $s$-energy. Beyond knowing the Hausdorff dimension of $\mathrm{supp}(\mu_{\mathrm{eq}})$, determine finer structural properties of the support: for example, characterize its topology, regularity, smoothness of its boundary, its precise location inside $C$, the cases in which it is lower-dimensional or coincides with $\partial C$ or with $C$ itself, and how these properties depend on $s$ and on the geometry of $C$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question of finer structural properties of the support of the Riesz s-energy equilibrium measure on a compact convex body is an active research direction. Recent work (e.g., Chafaï–Matzke–Saff–Vu–Womersley, "Riesz Energy with a Radial External Field: When is the Equilibrium Support a Sphere?", Potential Analysis 2025) addresses related questions in special radial settings, and related convexity/balayage results have appeared, but a complete description of the support on general convex bodies has not been established.

status_evidence.title: Riesz Energy with a Radial External Field: When is the Equilibrium Support a Sphere?
status_evidence.snippet: Develops conditions on radial external fields under which the Riesz equilibrium measure is supported on a sphere; characterizes dimension reduction for power fields.
status_evidence.claim: Finer structural properties of the equilibrium support are studied case-by-case; only special radial settings are fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Local Properties of Riesz Minimal Energy Configurations and Equilibrium Measures
status_evidence.snippet: Studies local properties of equilibrium measures and minimal energy configurations.
status_evidence.claim: Partial local structural results exist, but a general structural description of supp(μ_eq) on convex bodies is not given.

status_evidence.title: Ping pong balayage and convexity of the Riesz and logarithmic equilibrium measures
status_evidence.snippet: Convexity results for Riesz/logarithmic equilibrium measures via balayage.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial progress on structural properties of equilibrium measures.
